description_en: Updates a site's origin fetch rules
description_zh: 修改站点回源规则配置
name: UpdateOriginRule

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can get this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration ID
parameters.help_zh: 配置ID
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.help_en: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether the rule is enabled. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:

`on`: Enables the rule.

`off`: Disables the rule
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The rule content, which is a conditional expression that matches user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration.

To match all incoming requests, set the value to `true`.

To match specific requests, set the value to a custom expression, such as `(http.host eq "video.example.com")`
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true。
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

parameters.help_en: The `Host` header for the origin request
parameters.help_zh: 回源请求中携带的HOST
parameters.name: origin_host

parameters.help_en:
The protocol for origin requests. Valid values:

`http`: The origin request uses HTTP.

`https`: The origin request uses HTTPS.

`follow`: The origin request uses the same protocol as the client request
parameters.help_zh:
回源请求使用的协议。取值范围：
http：使用HTTP协议回源。
https：使用HTTPS协议回源。
follow：跟随客户端协议回源
parameters.name: origin_scheme

parameters.help_en: The Server Name Indication (SNI) for the origin request
parameters.help_zh: 回源请求中携带的SNI
parameters.name: origin_sni

parameters.help_en: Overrides the DNS record for the origin request
parameters.help_zh: 改写回源请求的DNS解析记录
parameters.name: dns_record

parameters.help_en: The origin server port for HTTP requests
parameters.help_zh: 使用HTTP协议回源时访问的源站端口
parameters.name: origin_http_port

parameters.help_en: The origin server port for HTTPS requests
parameters.help_zh: 使用HTTPS协议回源时访问的源站端口
parameters.name: origin_https_port

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to use range requests when fetching files from the origin server. Valid values:

`on`: Enables range requests.

`off`: Disables range requests.

`force`: Enforces range requests
parameters.help_zh:
使用range分片方式回源下载文件。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭。
force：强制
parameters.name: range

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to enable mutual TLS (mTLS) for origin requests. Valid values:

`on`: Enables mTLS.

`off`: Disables mTLS
parameters.help_zh:
mtls开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: origin_mtls

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to enable origin certificate verification. Valid values:

`on`: Enables verification.

`off`: Disables verification
parameters.help_zh:
源站证书校验开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: origin_verify

parameters.help_en:
The size of each chunk for range requests. Valid values:

512KB

1MB

2MB

4MB
parameters.help_zh:
range分片大小。取值范围：
512KB
1MB
2MB
4MB
parameters.name: range_chunk_size

parameters.help_en: The execution priority of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence

parameters.help_en: The read timeout period for the origin server, in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 源站读超时时间（秒）
parameters.name: origin_read_timeout

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to follow 302 redirects for origin requests. Valid values:

`on`: Follows 302 redirects.

`off`: Does not follow 302 redirects
parameters.help_zh:
回源302跟随开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: follow_302_enable

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of 302 redirects to follow. The value must be an integer from 1 to 5
parameters.help_zh: 302跟随次数上限，取值范围[1-5]
parameters.name: follow_302_max_tries

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to retain the original request parameters when following a 302 redirect. Valid values:

`on`: Retains the parameters.

`off`: Does not retain the parameters
parameters.help_zh:
保留原始请求参数开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: follow_302_retain_args

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to retain the original request headers when following a 302 redirect. Valid values:

`on`: Retains the headers.

`off`: Does not retain the headers
parameters.help_zh:
保留原始请求头开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: follow_302_retain_header

parameters.help_en: The `Host` header for the redirected origin request
parameters.help_zh: 修改302后的回源host
parameters.name: follow_302_target_host
